items.quote: 16:20 Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
items.claim: Some Israelites disobeyed Moses by keeping manna overnight, which caused it to breed worms and stink, angering Moses
items.action: hearkened not unto, left, bred, stank, was wroth
